note: Six single runs by one model, three subjects, two arms. Lookups are the agent's own report; toolCalls and context come from the harness that ran the agent. Subjects were fictional and given inline, so no run needed to gather evidence.
limitations: One model, one run per cell, subjects written by the author. Token figures are the harness's total for the agent, which includes the pasted Skill text in the Skill-only arm and excludes nothing the agent read; the Skill-only saving is small (about 1,000 to 2,400 tokens per run) because the Skill text itself is in the prompt, and a real install may load it differently. toolCalls includes the final hand-back call and the single Write that saved the record. Instruction lookups are self-reported and differ in how they were counted (the third baseline counted five sources, the others two). Evidence lookups were not exercised. Whether the records are better is a judgment, reported in do.md, not a pass.
